  Scenario: AC8 A retried or timed-out approval activity writes at most one entry (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the approval activity of the feeApproval branch has written its entry for instruction INS-2026-000712 and its completion is not received
    When the activity is retried or times out and runs again
    Then the retry answers the entry already written and writes nothing again
    Then the instruction is left as the flow left it and no partial entry is kept

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer approves nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock fails or does not answer the fee schedule read
    When the partner and agency manager approves the claim
    Then the approval is refused and nothing is written
    Then the claim stays open with no decision recorded
